title: Review and optimise Supplies costs
finding: Supplies is your largest expense at RM1550.00, contributing to an overall expense ratio of 20.0% of revenue.
recommendation: Examine your supplies spending and look for cheaper suppliers, bulk-buy discounts, or items you can defer. Even a 10-15% reduction in this category would meaningfully improve your bottom line.
rationale: Cutting your largest cost category has the biggest impact on profit. Small businesses often overpay for supplies or services because they don't shop around -- a quick review can yield immediate savings.

title: Diversify revenue beyond Printing
finding: Printing accounts for 62.7% of total revenue, indicating high concentration risk.
recommendation: Develop your other service category or add a complementary offering so that no single category dominates your revenue. Aim for a more balanced split (e.g., no category above 60%).
rationale: Relying too heavily on one revenue stream is risky -- if demand for that service drops, your income drops with it. Diversification makes your business more resilient.

title: Expand your most profitable service: Printing
